tool.name: ampvis2 merge ampvis2 data sets

param.name: input
param.label: Input
param.help: An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained by the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools).

param.name: merge_by_exact_matches
param.label: Merge by exact matches between DNA reference sequences
param.help: If checked, the full DNA sequences will be used as the new OTU ID's. If not checked, the OTU ID's are used as is. It's important to ensure that the taxonomy for all OTU's across data sets is generated in the exact same way with the same database. When **Merge by exact matches between DNA reference sequences** is not checked it's likewise important to ensure that OTU ID's are not arbitrary between data sets and that they are corresponding to the same sequences across data sets (objects).

tool.help:
What it does ============
Merge any number of ampvis2 data sets into a single data set.
The Galaxy tool calls the `amp_merge_ampvis2 <https://kasperskytte.github.io/ampvis2/reference/amp_merge_ampvis2.html>`_ function of the ampvis2 package.
Input =====
An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained by the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools).
Details =======
It's important to ensure that the taxonomy for all OTU's across data sets is generated in the exact same way with the same database. When **Merge by exact matches between DNA reference sequences** is not checked it's likewise important to ensure that OTU ID's are not arbitrary between data sets and that they are corresponding to the same sequences across data sets (objects). When **Merge by exact matches between DNA reference sequences** is checked the full DNA sequences will be used as the new OTU ID's.
Currently, phylogenetic trees are not merged.
Output ======
The merged data set
